# Central Massachusetts — 1:1 Minecraft Recreation

Minecraft Java (1.20.4) world built at **1 block = 1 meter** from:
- **USGS 3DEP 1-meter** elevation (LiDAR-derived bare-earth terrain)
- **Esri World Imagery** aerial photography (surface land-cover coloring)

## What's inside (one georeferenced world)
- **Worcester + Lake Quinsigamond + Shrewsbury** — 8.2 km × 3.4 km swath
- **Princeton + Mount Wachusett** — 3.0 km × 4.6 km (summit 612 m captured)
- 164,617 chunks; true 1:1 horizontal scale; per-tile 1:1 vertical datum.

The world file (CentralMassachusetts_1to1.zip, ~77 MB) is delivered on the
GitHub branch `claude/minecraft-central-mass-build-i4akc1` (it exceeds the
inline size Google Drive's connector accepts). Unzip into your Minecraft
`saves/` folder and open it as a 1.20.4 world.

See compare_worcester.jpg / compare_wachusett.jpg: top = satellite,
bottom = the generated world (hillshaded read-back of the actual blocks).
